versions.name: Textile
versions.description: Compare cotton, wool, nylon and rayon under a magnifier, follow raw fiber through spinning and weaving into cloth, then make felt, dye a garment with color you brewed, or weave on a loom you built.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
